# Tiger Realtors

> Tiger Realtors (Tiger Realtors Gaur City) is a property advisor in Gaur City 1, Gaur City 2, Greater Noida West and Noida Extension, Uttar Pradesh, India. It helps with residential sales and resale, rentals, commercial shops and offices, turnkey interiors and property maintenance.

Office: Shop No FFK3, Galaxy Plaza, Gaur City 1, Sector 4, Greater Noida West, Uttar Pradesh 201301 · Phone and WhatsApp: +91 87439 10094 · Open every day, 9:30 AM to 8:30 PM

## Services

- [Property sales and resale](https://tigerrealtors.in/services/property-sales/): buy or sell flats in Gaur City.
- [Rentals](https://tigerrealtors.in/services/rentals/): flats for rent, tenant and owner services.
- [Commercial property](https://tigerrealtors.in/services/commercial-property/): shops and offices, including Galaxy Plaza.
- [Turnkey interiors](https://tigerrealtors.in/services/turnkey-interiors/): interior design, modular kitchens and wardrobes.
- [Property maintenance](https://tigerrealtors.in/services/property-maintenance/): repairs, cleaning and waterproofing, including for owners living outside Noida or abroad.
